model.posterior_transport: native project posterior -> float16 -> float32 -> normalize

experiment.motion_reference: nearest accepted RGB frame to each LiDAR timestamp

calibration.brier_definition: sum over project classes; not divided by K

ablation.interpretation: Single-frame argmax is unchanged. Weighted accuracy is a diagnostic ranking statistic; VoxelMap results test fusion.

warnings: Checkpoint cannot emit project classes: electric_bicycle, chair, bench; their GT rows are retained but excluded from primary metrics.
Full posterior storage was disabled; per_point.csv retains only confidence, GT probability and entropy.
Voxel ablation includes a moving ego or moving targets; dynamic world-coordinate trails can confound reliability effects.
Motion V2 is a frame-level relative-pose risk prior, not measured per-point reprojection error; its CARLA parameters are experimental.
IMU Motion V1 is retained only as a diagnostic and does not enter the full reliability product.
